words.definition: Fanatical and uncompromising pursuit of ideals.
words.example: Religious zealotry has led to many conflicts throughout history.

words.definition: Having great energy for a cause or objective.
words.example: She was zealous in her commitment to environmental protection.

words.definition: The defining spirit of a particular period.
words.example: The film perfectly captures the zeitgeist of the 1990s.

words.definition: The highest point reached; the peak.
words.example: The empire reached its zenith in the fifteenth century.

words.definition: Great enthusiasm and energy.
words.example: She approached every new challenge with zest and optimism.

words.definition: A line with alternate sharp turns.
words.example: The path made a zigzag up the steep mountainside.

words.definition: A belt of the heavens with twelve constellations.
words.example: Ancient astrologers divided the sky into the signs of the zodiac.

words.definition: The scientific study of animals.
words.example: She studied zoology at university before working at the zoo.
